checks.name: behavior-lock-help
checks.stdout:
behavior-lock v0.2.0

Lock your software's behavior before AI touches the code.

Usage:
  behavior-lock init
  behavior-lock record
  behavior-lock record --name <name> -- <command> [args...]
  behavior-lock record --json --name <name> -- <command> [args...]
  behavior-lock verify [--json]
  behavior-lock --help
  behavior-lock --version

Exit codes:
  0  behavior unchanged / record succeeded
  1  behavioral changes detected
  2  configuration or execution error
